## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves

Explain the problem this feature would solve. Ex: "I'm always frustrated when..."

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternative Solutions

Have you considered any alternative approaches?

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.

## Benefits

- [ ] Developers using DevIntel
- [ ] Contributors to DevIntel
- [ ] DevIntel maintainers
- [ ] Other: _______

## Implementation Complexity (Your Estimate)

- [ ] Low (< 1 day)
- [ ] Medium (1-3 days)
- [ ] High (> 3 days)
- [ ] Unknown

## Willing to Contribute?

- [ ] Yes, I can implement this feature
- [ ] Yes, I can help test this feature  
- [ ] No, but I'd love to see it implemented
